verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸਨ ਲੈ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਜਗਿ ਮਹਮਾ ਦਸਮ ਸਕੰਧੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: kisan lai avataar jag mahamaa dhasam saka(n)dh vakhaanai|

en.bdb: The tenth chapter of the Bhagavat defines the glory of incarnation of Krsna in the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੀਲਾ ਚਲਤ ਅਚਰਜ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: leelaa chalat acharaj kar jog bhog ras raleeaa maanai|

en.bdb: He performed many wonderful acts of bhog (merriment) and yoga (renunciation).

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਭਾਰਥੁ ਕਰਵਾਇਓਨੁ ਕੈਰੋ ਪਾਂਡੋ ਕਰਿ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: mahaa bhaarath karavaion kairo paa(n)ddo kar hairaanai|

en.bdb: Making Kauravs (sons of Dhrttrastr) and Pandays to fight against each other he further made them wonder struck.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਦਿਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕਾ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਮਿਤਿ ਮਿਰਜਾਦ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: ei(n)dhraadhik brahamaadhikaa mahimaa mit mirajaadh na jaanai|

en.bdb: Indr and Brahma et al. donot know the limits of his grandeur.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੀਆ ਟਹਲਾ ਵੰਡਿ ਕੈ ਜਗਿ ਰਾਜਸੂ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: mileeaa Tahalaa va(n)dd kai jag raajasoo raaje raanai|

en.bdb: When Raisfiy was arranged by Yudhisthar, all were alloted their duties.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੰਗ ਲਈ ਹਰਿ ਟਹਲ ਏਹ ਪੈਰ ਧੋਇ ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਮਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: ma(n)g liee har Tahal eh pair dhoi charanodhak maanai|

en.bdb: Krsna himself tookover the duty of washing of the feet of all so that through this service
He could realise the importance of the service of the holy congregation and the Word of the Guru.
